description: Animates an artboard with motion presets that suit it (the headline rises or types in, the rest follows) — one undo step in the person’s design — and returns a short looping GIF made by Paletoo’s own export, so the chat shows it moving. Needs the design open in Paletoo (its editor plays and records the motion); otherwise it says so.

artboard.description: an artboard id (get_design); none: the first

design.description: the design’s id or Paletoo link

preset.description: the headline’s motion; none: picked to suit

name: motion_preview
title: Animate and preview
